notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261002-002338-w3F0. The smallest useful next step is a clean replay in a fresh worker context with one new FX_ Form. This revision makes the coupled-unload prerequisite explicit: before the unload, `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` must still be observed CHECKED/enabled and must not be changed. If it is not CHECKED, the replay must stop BLOCKED before any unload rather than silently testing a different non-coupled condition. The replay remains independent of EXP-004, the blocked EXP-005-R2 isolation design, and the separate unresolved IDO-trigger-timing question. A successful replay would justify promoting only the literal User-scope Caption persistence procedure across this same coupled cache boundary from observed to replay-verified.
